parameters.name: AddrPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the values of specific response parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: LbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy of the address pool. Valid values:

*   ALL_RR: returns all addresses.
*   RATIO: returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-gtm-address-pool --lang en --addr-pool-id testp000000 --name testpoolname --lba-strategy ALL_RR --addr AttributeInfo=Linecode:_default_lineCodes：_default_lineCodeRectifyType:_AUTO LbaWeight=1 Mode=SMART Addr=1.1.XX.XX Remark=test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDnsGtmAddressPool --region cn-hangzhou --Addr.1.AttributeInfo 'Linecode:_default_lineCodes：_default_lineCodeRectifyType:_AUTO' --LbaStrategy ALL_RR --Addr.1.Mode SMART --AddrPoolId testp000000 --Lang en --Addr.1.LbaWeight 1 --Addr.1.Addr '1.1.XX.XX' --Addr.1.Remark test --Name testpoolname
